initial_conditions: The original Harbor revision 23 opened in the current Apple Silicon studio with both patterns framed.
actions: Open the saved Harbor project, choose Frame all and save a workspace PNG.
Select Harbor front in Scene, use Hide selected, and save a workspace PNG.
Use File > Export GLB while Harbor front is hidden.
Use Show all, reselect Harbor front, choose Isolate selected, Frame all, and save a workspace PNG.
Reopen the same saved project and inspect the restored pattern rows.
expected_outcomes: Both views reflect Hide and Isolate. Each hidden Scene row remains labeled. Show all and reopening restore visibility. The editable file and complete GLB keep their original bytes.
